title: A verified exact scientific calculator across numerical and interface layers
description:
An exact scientific calculator from decimal input to rational browser output, with certified root and series enclosures and transactional rejection.

Maria Smith derives exact decimal parsing, rational arithmetic, root bisection, exponential and logarithmic remainder bounds, the circle-angle identity, parser precedence and session admission. The paper includes native Lean source correspondence, exhaustive calculator and browser classifications, 1,281 distinct empty-axiom audited definitions and theorems, whole-programme comparison evidence and actual browser execution. Exact source, reproducible rational checks and complete mathematical arguments accompany the PDF.
